title: Internship offer
description: Offer of internship: addressee page, terms of internship and acceptance page.

params.subject: Subject: Offer of internship – {designation}
opening: We are pleased to offer you an internship with **{company}** as **{designation}**.
The internship is meant to give you practical experience of the work of our team, alongside experienced colleagues and on live projects.
The internship will start on **{startDate}** and end on **{endDate}**, unless it is extended or ended earlier as set out in this letter.

opening.text: You will receive a monthly stipend of **{stipend} ({stipendWords})**.

opening: We look forward to working with you.

clauses.title: Internship Position
paragraphs: You are offered the position of **{designation}**. You will support the team in the work assigned to you by your reporting manager, including research, development, testing and documentation.

clauses.title: Duration
paragraphs: The internship runs from **{startDate}** to **{endDate}**.
The Company may extend the internship depending on project needs and your performance.
Completing the internship does not by itself entitle you to employment with the Company, although good performance may be taken into account for future openings.

clauses.title: Reporting
paragraphs: You will report to {reportingTo}.
You are expected to complete the tasks assigned to you on time and to take part in reviews, discussions and team meetings.

clauses.title: Place of Work
paragraphs: Your place of work will be {placeOfWork}.
Depending on the needs of the work, you may be asked to work remotely, in a hybrid arrangement or at another location.

clauses.title: Working Hours
paragraphs: Normal working hours are **{workingHours}**, **{workingDays}**.
You are expected to be punctual and to attend regularly. Longer hours may occasionally be needed to meet deadlines.

clauses.title: Stipend
paragraphs: You will receive a monthly stipend of **{stipend} ({stipendWords})**, paid through the normal payment process of the Company.
The stipend is not a salary and does not create any right to the benefits of employees.

clauses.title: Leave
paragraphs: Leave during the internship needs the prior approval of your reporting manager.

paragraphs.text: Absence without approval may lead to a reduction of the stipend, an extension of the internship or its early end.
Absence without approval may lead to an extension of the internship or its early end.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
paragraphs: You will keep confidential all information about the Company that you receive during the internship, including:
bullets: Source code, designs and technical documentation
Processes and know-how of the Company
after: You will not copy, disclose or use such information except for the work of the Company. This obligation continues for **{confidentialityPeriod}** after the internship ends.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
paragraphs: All work that you create or contribute to during the internship, including software, documents, designs and inventions, belongs to **{company}**.

clauses.title: Code of Conduct
paragraphs: You will follow the policies of the Company, including those on information security, the use of Company equipment, workplace conduct and professional ethics.
Misconduct or a breach of these policies may lead to the immediate end of the internship.

clauses.title: Evaluation
paragraphs: Your performance will be reviewed from time to time, taking into account your skills, attitude to learning, quality of work, communication, teamwork and conduct.

clauses.title: Ending the Internship
paragraphs: Either party may end the internship by giving **{noticePeriod}** of written notice.
The Company may end the internship immediately in the case of misconduct, a breach of confidentiality, false information or a serious breach of its policies.

clauses.title: Documents
paragraphs: On your first day, please submit copies of:
bullets: A signed copy of this letter

clauses.title: Internship Certificate
paragraphs: When you complete the internship satisfactorily, the Company may issue an internship certificate.

paragraphs.text: This letter is governed by the laws of {governingLaw}. The courts at {jurisdiction} will have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from the internship.
This letter is governed by the laws of {governingLaw}. Any dispute arising from the internship will be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Offer
paragraphs: Please sign and return a copy of this letter within {acceptanceDays} of receiving it.
I accept the offer of internship and agree to join **{company}** on **{startDate}**.
acceptance.closing: We look forward to having you as part of our team.
